descriptions.en:
Mirror non-system menu bar status items inside NotchAny. It preserves the live order and visual appearance, supports standard clicks, adapts from one row to multi-row layouts, and refreshes on workspace events with a polling fallback.

Requires Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions. All processing stays on your Mac.
descriptions.zh-Hans:
在 NotchAny 刘海中镜像非系统菜单栏状态项，保留实时顺序和图标外观，支持标准单击，并会根据组件尺寸从单行自动调整为多行布局。应用启动、退出、唤醒和空间切换会触发刷新，同时保留低频轮询兜底。

需要辅助功能与屏幕录制权限，所有处理均在本机完成。

summaries.en: Mirror and click third-party macOS menu bar items from the notch.
summaries.zh-Hans: 在刘海中镜像并点击第三方 macOS 菜单栏状态项。
